facts.big: verbo base · how many · how much
facts.label: Dia de chuva
facts.sub: Use o verbo base para ordens: Read, Bring, Go. Use how many com plural e how much para preço: How many museums are there? How much is it?

facts.label: Ordens
facts.sub: O imperativo usa o verbo base: Read this list. Bring your card. Go early. Take an umbrella. Para ficar mais educado, use please antes ou depois: Please bring your card.

facts.label: Quantos
facts.sub: Use how many com plural: How many museums are there? How many hours is it open? Depois de how many, o substantivo fica no plural.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “leia a lista” e “traga seu cartão”.

group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: An imperative uses the base verb.
We say “You bring your card” as an order.
How many asks about a number.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: An imperative uses the base verb. → Verdadeiro (Yes: Read, Bring, Go.)
We say “You bring your card” as an order. → Falso (We say Bring your card.)
How many asks about a number. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

paragraphs: It is a grey Sunday in Boston. Rain runs down the hotel window. Pia sits on the bed with a map. Dan comes out of the shower. They cannot go to the beach today. Pia calls him over.
“It’s raining again, Dan! Come and look at the map.” says Pia. “Let’s plan a day inside. How many museums are there?” says Dan. “There are four. Read this list.” says Pia.
